text: dsh-upload-button（DSH Web 插件）：为对话输入框添加图片上传按钮。它注册到 conversation.input.left 插槽，支持从本地文件选择多张图片，并通过现有草稿图片流程加入对话缩略图栏，供随消息发送和图像理解。另附独立的 DashScope 文生图脚本，可提交任务、轮询并保存图片。上传按钮无需额外配置；脚本需 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY。

dsh-upload-button adds an image picker to the DSH Web composer through conversation.input.left. Selected local images enter the draft-image chat flow. A separate DashScope helper generates images; it requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY. Uploading needs no extra configuration.
想在 DSH 网页对话里直接选本地图片发送。
能不能在输入框旁边加一个图片上传按钮？
我需要一次把几张图片放进对话草稿。
让 DSH 的图片走原来的缩略图和发送流程。
我想把图片交给对话里的 AI 做图像理解。
有没有办法不用拖放，也能把电脑里的图片加到消息里？
I want to attach several local images to a DSH Web message.
Add an image picker next to the chat composer controls.
dsh-upload-button 的功能「选择并添加图片」：点击 composer 旁的上传按钮会打开图片文件选择器，支持多选。选中的文件通过对话的草稿图片接收流程添加到当前输入区。
dsh-upload-button 的功能「沿用草稿图片流程」：插件为所选文件创建 DataTransfer，并向 document 派发 drop 事件，使图片进入对话既有的草稿处理路径。
dsh-upload-button 的功能「注册输入框按钮」：浏览器端插件把上传组件注册到 conversation.input.left 插槽，显示在对话 composer 的左侧工具区。
dsh-upload-button 的功能「DashScope 文生图辅助脚本」：tools/gen-image.js 接收提示词，提交 wanx2.1-t2i-turbo 任务并轮询结果，最后把图片保存到指定路径或默认临时目录。
dsh-upload-button 使用前须知：随附文生图脚本会把提示词发送到 DashScope，并需配置 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY；生成图片随后从服务返回的 URL 下载。

dsh-upload-button README · dsh-upload-button：Upload-image button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

Adds an **upload button** beside the composer plus button: click it, pick local
images, and they enter the composer's draft-image rail as thumbnails. On send,
the images ride the standard draft-image path, so describe-image (or any other
image consumer) receives them as usual — validation, size limits, and the
thumbnail rail all come from the official conversation flow. **No harness
source changes.**

dsh-upload-button README · dsh-upload-button：Also ships `tools/gen-image.js`, a text-to-image helper that calls the Alibaba
DashScope native image-synthesis API (`wanx2.1-t2i-turbo`).

dsh-upload-button README · Features：- Upload button on the `conversation.input.left` slot (beside the plus/command button)
- Multi-select file picker (images only — the conversation draft rail is image-only today)
- Reuses the official draft-image drop path: synthetic `DataTransfer` + `drop` event on `document`
- Zero harness changes, pure browser-side plugin
dsh-upload-button README · Install：```sh
dsh-upload-button README · from GitHub source：dsh plugin --profile web add github:victorytianyi-dev/dsh-upload-button

dsh-upload-button README · or via link (local dev)：dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-upload-button
```

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6+`.

dsh-upload-button README · Usage：1. After install and (re)start, open any session.
2. Next to the **+** button in the composer there is an **upload** button (⬆).
3. Click it, pick one or more images.
4. Thumbnails appear in the draft rail; type a message and send.

dsh-upload-button README · How it works：The plugin registers on the official `conversation.input.left` slot (list,
session scope). Picking files builds a `DataTransfer`, then dispatches a
synthetic `drop` event to `document` — the exact path a real drag/paste takes,
so the conversation's own image intake (type checks, limits, thumbnails) runs
unchanged.
